body:
# Pulse Boost

Pulse Boost is an ultra-lightweight Fabric modpack designed to deliver the highest possible performance with minimal resource usage.

Built specifically for Android devices and launcher users, Pulse Boost includes carefully selected optimization mods that improve FPS, reduce memory usage, speed up loading times, and provide a smoother Minecraft experience without changing the core vanilla gameplay.

## Features

### - ⚡ Maximum FPS optimization
### - 📱 Designed for Android, Mojo Launcher, and PojavLauncher
### - 🚀 Faster loading times
### - 🟢 Reduced memory usage
### - 🌐 Multiplayer-friendly
### - 🎮 Vanilla Minecraft experience

## Perfect For

### - Low-end devices
### - Competitive players
### - Survival gameplay
### - Multiplayer servers
### - Players who want maximum performance

Pulse Boost focuses on one goal: delivering the smoothest possible gameplay on any device.

# Pulse Boost — Maximum Performance. Minimal Overhead.
